description: If the input equation pairs lie in \(S\times S\), the bounded closure is an equivalence relation on \(S\) and obeys restricted function congruence.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.closure_congruence.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L))
  (E : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) (hE : E ⊆ S.product S) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.IsCongruence S fun t s =>
    (t, s) ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.closure S E
